component.name: WireView Pro II
component.summary: Monitor a Thermal Grizzly WireView Pro II GPU power meter

description.p: Unofficial Linux GUI for the Thermal Grizzly WireView Pro II GPU power monitor. It shows real-time voltage, current and power across all pins with live charts, lets you configure the device, log data to CSV, and raise desktop notifications on fault.
The app talks to the device directly over USB serial — no .NET runtime is required, and the optional wireview-hwmon kernel module is not needed.
This is an unofficial, community-made port. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Thermal Grizzly or ElmorLabs.

screenshot.caption: Overview with live per-wire power, current and temperature

description.p: Fix phantom fault alerts: discard corrupt serial frames and debounce fault bits before alerting.
Beta: LAN monitoring - read, publish, and remotely configure WireViews on other machines over the LAN (HMAC-authenticated, off by default).
Adds a system-tray power readout with a live hwmon values dropdown.
